Serve as a senior legal counsel for Binance’s global Corporate Legal Affairs team, delivering complex strategic projects together with corporate transactions, governance, reorganisations, intra-group arrangements, board secretarial and entity management.

lists.content:
• Drive the development and implementation of group legal strategy and contribute to the delivery of the organization’s general business strategy.
  • Provide proactive, in-depth, business focused advice and execution.
  • Manage and assist with legal response to corporate and wider matters encountered by the company and internal stakeholders and provide sound and robust legal advice and support; and leading external communication on legal matters including negotiation with external parties.
  • Lead, advise and support a wide variety of transactional, reorganisation and corporate governance initiatives.
  • Assist in transactional activities including M&A, majority and minority investments and joint ventures as well as restructurings globally.
  • Be responsible for drafting and reviewing legal documents and providing holistic risk assessment and suggestions to enhance business value while mitigating downside risk across multiple areas of the company.
  • Partner with cross-functional and regional teams and provide support on legal matters of varying complexity, sensitivity, and tangibility.
  • Provide training and counsel non-legal colleagues to promote greater awareness and risk management across the company.
  • Anticipate and maintain up-to-date knowledge of current laws.
  • Identify legal framework developments, align and promote consistency of approach in legal matters between the internal stakeholders.
  • Take prudent risks within the context of the overall business, and advise and implement solutions to address issues identified.

• Qualified to practice law in a leading jurisdiction with significant corporate legal experience.
  • Typically 8+ years of post qualification experience (as a guide) working at a top law firm and/or in-house at a well-established corporate or high-growth company.
  • Ideally trained in a reputable law firm within the corporate practice with a focus on corporate transactional work and general corporate governance.
  • Proven expertise in managing complex projects across multiple jurisdictions globally.
  • Possesses strong legal technical expertise as well as exceptional business acumen and people skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced in-house environment is essential.
  • Strong team player and good business sense.
  • Hands on at work and can be independent in managing complex projects whilst still working as part of a team.
  • Ability to come up with and execute creative solutions to meet current and evolving business needs.
  • Excellent legal drafting and interpretation skills.
  • Excellent problem solving, analytical and organisational skills.

lists.content:
Governance & Policy
  • Design, maintain, and iterate on platform content policies and community guidelines.
  • Define moderation standards for crypto-specific content risk: scams, market manipulation, misinformation, harmful financial advice.
  • Drive policy enforcement frameworks — balancing automation with AI review.
    • Moderation Operations
  • Oversee day-to-day moderation operations, including internal teams and outsourced vendors.
  • Optimize moderation workflows and quality assurance processes.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to improve AI moderation tools, AI classifiers, and reporting systems.
    • Ecosystem Risk Management
  • Monitor emerging threats and abuse patterns across the platform.
  • Lead incident response for high-severity content violations and crisis scenarios.
  • Develop escalation protocols and cross-team coordination mechanisms.
  • Work with Legal, Compliance, and Policy teams to align governance with global regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Creator Ops to educate and communicate policy changes to the creator community.
  • Represent Binance Square's governance philosophy to internal and external stakeholders.
    • Data & Reporting
  • Define and track governance KPIs: moderation accuracy, turnaround time, user appeals, ecosystem health trends.
  • Produce regular transparency reports and insights for leadership

• 5–8+ years in trust & safety, content moderation, or platform governance at a major internet/social platform.
  • Deep understanding of crypto, blockchain, and Web3 — able to identify crypto-native risks and bad actors.
  • Experience managing moderation teams and vendor relationships at scale.
  • Strong policy-writing and decision-making skills under ambiguity.
  • Data-driven; comfortable with dashboards, SQL, and operational metrics.
  • Fluent English (verbal & written); calm, decisive under pressure.

About The Opportunity: 
This role sits within our Data Analytics function, supporting the Trading Business Unit. You'll partner closely with trading, operations, and product teams to turn large-scale data into insights that drive fast, high-stakes decisions.

lists.content:
• Work across all aspects of data — from engineering to building sophisticated visualisations, machine learning models and experiments — in support of the Trading business
  • Analyze and interpret large (PB-scale) volumes of transactional, operational and customer data using proprietary and open source data tools, platforms and analytical tool kits
  • Translate complex findings into simple visualisations and recommendations for execution by trading, operational teams and executives
  • Be part of a fast-paced industry and organisation where time to market is critical

• Degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics/Statistics, Actuarial Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or Life Sciences
  • At least 3 years of full-time work experience in an Analytics or Data Science role
  • You have rich trading/financial derivatives experience (hard-requirement) 
  • A natural curiosity to identify, investigate and explain trends and patterns in data, and an ability to break down complex concepts and technical findings into clear, simple language
  • Prior internal/client-facing consulting/business transformation experience preferred
  • A passion for Emerging Technologies related to Blockchain, Machine Learning and AI

    • Competency in two or more of the following:

    • An analytical software (e.g. R, SAS)
    • A data visualisation tool (e.g. Qlikview, Tableau, PowerBI)
    • A relational or graph database management tool (e.g. SQL, NoSQL, Neo4J)
    • Programming (e.g. VBA, C++, Java, Python)

About the Role

We are building our own IDC infrastructure from the ground up. As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will lead the architecture, buildout, and operations of our colocation data center — from rack layout to the on-prem Kubernetes platform. You build it, you own it. This is a true greenfield role with no legacy baggage and a high degree of architectural ownership.

Your core expertise will center on three pillars: building physical infrastructure from zero, running production-grade self-hosted Kubernetes, and hybrid-cloud interconnect. As the platform matures, you'll help drive the next phase of cross-cloud and scale-out buildout.

lists.content:
• Design rack layout, network topology, and overall configuration for colocation

  • Design and implement an isolated Out-of-Band (OOB) management network (BMC, IPMI, Redfish) with full security hardening

  • Coordinate with colocation and hardware vendors — servers, switches, cross-connects, uplinks, remote hands, and cage/rack administration

  • Build bare-metal automation for fleet-wide zero-touch OS provisioning (MAAS / Tinkerbell / Cluster API)

  • Set up production-grade self-hosted Kubernetes clusters from scratch and maintain the core stack: Cilium (CNI), GitOps (ArgoCD), etc.

  • Own cluster lifecycle: upgrades, scaling, node maintenance, incident response

  • Write SOPs, runbooks, and post-mortems; participate in 24×7 on-call rotation

  • Establish hybrid-cloud interconnect between IDC and public cloud (VPN / Direct Connect / peering)

  • Pave the way for scale-out: GPU workloads (NVIDIA GPU Operator, passthrough, MIG) and VM workloads running alongside containers (KubeVirt or similar)

• 5+ years in data center / infrastructure / platform engineering

  • Hands-on experience building physical infrastructure from scratch: rack layout, network topology, server commissioning, and coordinating cross-connects and remote hands with colo / vendors

  • Practical experience designing and operating OOB management networks (BMC, IPMI, Redfish)

  • Have stood up production-grade self-hosted Kubernetes from scratch, and can independently debug cluster-level issues (CNI, CSI, storage)

  • Strong Linux systems administration and performance tuning (kernel, networking, storage I/O)

  • Bare-metal automation experience with at least one of: MAAS, Tinkerbell, Cluster API

  • Proficient with Terraform, Ansible, and at least one scripting language (Python / Go / Bash)

  • Experience with Cisco network and related techniques (VLAN, LACP/LAG, BGP, ACL, etc)

  • Experience with Palo Alto firewall configuration

  • Experience with storage systems (NetApp, Dell EMC, Pure Storage)

  • Fluent in English or Mandrain

    • Nice to Have

  • High-density racks (30kW+) and 400G+ networking experience

  • Familiarity with immutable OS (Talos Linux / Flatcar / Bottlerocket)

  • Proficiency across both AWS and GCP; cross-cloud data migration experience

  • Experience building storage or Bigdata / offline data clusters

  • Virtualization experience (KubeVirt or similars)

  • Exposure to NVIDIA GPU Operator and K8s GPU workloads

  • CKA / CKS certification

  • CCNP / CCIE certification

  • Professional-level Japanese

job_detail_fetch.descriptionPlain:
Calling top-tier AI and Web3 innovators from around the globe!  Binance is building the world’s foremost crypto and Web3 platform—and we’re just getting started. We’re assembling a lean, elite LLM Algorithm & Data Science Team (3–5 members) to pioneer next-generation AI solutions in finance, blockchain, and beyond. If you’re young, passionate, and driven by cutting-edge research, this is your moment to make history. 

What You’ll Build: 

We’re not here to retrofit yesterday’s models—we’re here to invent tomorrow’s:

-Web3 Data Lake LLM
Ingest and reason over massive on-chain and off-chain datasets to power real-time insights.

-Trading System LLM
Design intelligent trading agents, signal generators, and strategy-optimization engines.

-Compliance and Regulatory LLM 
Automate compliance, travel-rule enforcement, and on-chain forensics at scale.

.…and beyond
From customer-service agents and personalized navigation experiences to completely new AI-powered Web3 applications.

Your creations will underpin multiple internal products—customer support bots, trading-signal dashboards, compliance workflows, user-experience agents—while also bootstrapping entirely new AI-Web3 innovations.

lists.content:
• Regional PR Strategy & Leadership:
  • Develop and execute an integrated PR and communications strategy for Southeast Asia, aligned with Binance’s global positioning and regional considerations.
  • Prioritize SEA, ensuring deeper media engagement, stronger visibility, and sustained brand credibility.
  • Adapt messaging and approach where appropriate, focusing on compliance-safe communications and reputation management.
    •  
  • Media Relations & Thought Leadership:
  • Build, maintain, and expand strong relationships with top-tier, business, financial, and tech media across the region.
  • Secure consistent, high-quality media coverage including interviews, op-eds, commentary, and feature stories.
  • Position Binance spokespeople as credible thought leaders on crypto, blockchain, financial innovation, and regulation-aware growth.
    •  
  • Regulatory-Sensitive Communications:
  • Work closely with Legal, Compliance, and Policy teams to ensure all external communications are accurate, compliant, and risk-appropriate.
  • Support communications around regulatory developments, market restrictions, and compliance milestones in a clear and responsible manner.
  • Act as a key communications partner during issues management or crisis scenarios.
    •  
  • Campaigns, Launches & Corporate Announcements:
  • Lead PR planning and execution for product launches, partnerships, corporate announcements, and regional campaigns.
  • Ensure announcements are localized where appropriate while maintaining a consistent regional narrative.
  • Coordinate with global PR teams to align timing, messaging, and spokesperson strategy.
    •  
  • Agency & Stakeholder Management:
  • Manage and guide local PR agencies where applicable, ensuring clear briefs, high standards, and measurable outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Social, Community, Partnerships, and Global Comms teams.
  • Provide senior-level counsel to internal stakeholders on media strategy and public positioning.
    •  
  • Measurement & Reporting:
  • Track and analyze PR performance using key metrics (share of voice, sentiment, message pull-through, tier-1 coverage).
  • Deliver clear monthly and quarterly reports with insights, risks, and recommendations.
  • Continuously refine strategy based on data, market feedback, and regulatory context.

• Experience & Background:
  • 8–12+ years of experience in public relations, communications, or corporate affairs.
  • Strong background in financial services, fintech, technology, crypto, or regulated industries.
  • Direct, hands-on experience managing multi-market or regional PR strategies in Southeast Asia.
    •  
  • Skills & Competencies:
  • Excellent media instincts with strong storytelling and message framing skills.
  • High level of regulatory awareness and risk sensitivity.
  • Ability to operate strategically while remaining execution-focused.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-cultural communication skills.
  • Confident advisor to senior leaders and spokespersons.
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.
    •  
  • What Success Looks Like:
  • Binance is viewed as a credible, responsible, and authoritative voice in Southeast Asia.
  • Clear, consistent, and compliant communications across Southeast Asia.
  • Strong media relationships that translate into sustained, high-quality coverage.
  • Effective navigation of regulatory sensitivities with minimal reputational risk.

lists.content:
• Set the product direction and roadmap for margin financing & securities lending and clearing & settlement systems within the core trading infrastructure.
  • Own the architecture design of clearing and settlement systems — trade clearing, position and balance settlement, multilateral netting, fee and interest settlement, and reconciliation.
  • Improve core margin systems including collateral valuation, cross/isolated margin logic, interest accrual, borrow/lend flows, and liquidation handling.
  • Work with the trading engineering teams to turn complex financing and settlement needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Lead the full product lifecycle from planning to release and ongoing/new feature launch.
  • Monitor system performance, settlement integrity, and reconciliation accuracy; identify and resolve issues before they impact users.
  • Ensure systems comply with standards, regulations, and best practices.

• Deep understanding of margin financing / securities lending mechanics and clearing & settlement flows (netting, reconciliation, collateral management, interest accrual).
  • Experience designing or owning the architecture of clearing/settlement or margin systems, in either TradFi or crypto.
  • Technical or quantitative background (e.g., CS, Financial Engineering, Math).
  • Ability to understand trading logics, risk methods, and settlement flows, and translate them into product requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Product experience is not a must as long as you're interested in the job and you have past experience working on systems level tasks. 
  • Proficiency in Mandarin is preferred to coordinate with global stakeholders and overseas partners.

lists.content:
• Plan and launch listing campaign products, such as referral rewards and promotional events, to attract new users and improve retention and trading activity.
  • Develop a deep understanding of crypto spot trading rules and user behavior, and propose effective growth strategies to drive traffic, conversion, and trading volume.
  • Independently identify business problems and opportunities in listing campaigns and spot trading growth, and proactively drive solutions from ideation to execution.
  • Work closely with marketing, sales, engineering, risk management, legal, and operations teams to ensure smooth and compliant product launches.
  • Define and monitor key metrics for listing campaigns, analyze performance, identify optimization opportunities, and continuously improve product outcomes based on data and user feedback.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to stay on top of industry trends, user needs, and product innovations, and translate insights into actionable product initiatives.

• 5+ years of experience in product management or project management, preferably in crypto, trading, fintech, or other fast-paced internet industries.
  • Strong self-motivation and ownership mindset, with the ability to take full responsibility for projects and drive them forward with minimal supervision.
  • Strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently identify issues, structure problems clearly, and push solutions through to completion.
  • Highly responsible, execution-oriented, and detail-conscious, with a strong sense of accountability for both process and outcomes.
  • Good business judgment and market sensitivity, with the ability to understand user behavior, identify growth opportunities, and turn insights into practical product strategies.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, able to align stakeholders and work effectively across teams including engineering, listing, trading, marketing, risk, and legal.
  • Solid project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain momentum, and deliver high-quality results on time.
  • Deep interest in and understanding of the crypto industry, especially spot trading products, market dynamics, and user behavior.
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.

lists.content:

job_detail_fetch.descriptionPlain:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.


This role requires someone who can help the leadership create and drive strategy but also roll up their sleeves and get their hands dirty. You will be expected to help with all areas of the business, from administrative support, hiring, strategic thinking and general problem solving.

This role requires someone who can help the leadership create and drive strategy but also roll up their sleeves and get their hands dirty. You will be expected to help with all areas of the business, from administrative support, hiring, strategic thinking and general problem solving.

lists.content:
• Assist the leadership in leading expansion plans for the market and shape the plan for launching new services while ensuring strong coordination with Government Relations, Marketing and Tech teams along the way
  • Work with relevant business owners and country managers to ensure world-class operational standards in areas such as licensing, local exchange operations, products and growth etc. 
  • Work extensively with data dashboards to refine user experience, to monitor and report operating metrics to proactively identify areas of improvement and recommend and implement action plans
  • Partner with cross functional teams, using region specific data and insight to define changes, design experiments, and implement those changes across our product operations.

• 3+ years of proven success in a similar role - management consulting, operations at a high-growth start-up, etc

  • Data-focused: Able to roll up your sleeves to pull and analyze the data. Understand what data is needed and scale across the region

  • Strong communicator: outstanding executive-level verbal and written communication skills, ability to clearly explain complex business problems and build business cases and quantitative models that will inform and influence our operations strategy

  • Entrepreneurship mentality: Must be a self-starter and leader that assumes the risks and rewards of running an innovative sustainable operation

  • Cross-cultural interpersonal skills: Able to build and manage strong relationships with their team, cross-functional colleagues, and external partners

  • Passion for crypto and digital assets: We are trying to change an entire industry and it will take time. Passion is what gets you excited to come into work every morning

  • Experience with high-growth settings: comfort working in a high growth, constantly changing environment

  • English and Russian at business level to coordinate with different stakeholders.

We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Role Overview

Responsible for end-to-end quality assurance across Web and App (mobile) surfaces — combining automated and exploratory testing to ensure product stability, compatibility, and interaction experience from the user's perspective. The core requirement is cross-platform testing capability (Web + App), with the ability to design and maintain an automated testing system and to think deeply about troubleshooting and user-experience-oriented quality.

In one sentence: This role is the quality gatekeeper for Web/App products — someone who can write automation scripts, test interaction experiences, investigate data issues, and use engineering methods to replace manual testing with systematic automated quality coverage. Not a manual tester — a QA engineer with real coding ability.

lists.content:
• Design and maintain comprehensive Web/App test cases and test plans covering functionality, compatibility, and interaction
  • Develop and maintain UI/API automated tests using Java, Python, or JavaScript to ensure high coverage and reliability
  • Combine automation and manual exploratory testing to validate user scenarios and discover potential experience issues
  • Perform root cause analysis on test failures and production issues, and drive fixes to closure
  • Identify blind spots in test coverage and continuously improve automation effectiveness
  • Participate in testing for new features — define expected behaviors, system impact, and risk points from a user-experience perspective
  • Conduct App compatibility testing across devices, OS versions, and screen sizes, as well as Web cross-browser and cross-resolution testing
  • Participate in performance testing (page load time, App cold start / warm start, etc.) and ensure stability under high-concurrency and weak-network scenarios

• Strong coding ability in at least one of Java, Python, or JavaScript (live coding assessment required)
  • Extensive Web/App automation testing experience with tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, etc.
  • Solid understanding of Web/App testing methodologies and automation framework design
  • Proficiency in SQL for data validation and issue troubleshooting
  • Proven root cause analysis ability to solve complex quality problems
  • Familiarity with Web front-end technologies (HTML/CSS/JS) and mobile platform fundamentals (Android/iOS architecture and characteristics)
  • Experience building testing tools, platforms, or quality infrastructure

Background:

  • 1–5 years of QA or test development experience, including at least 1 year of Web or App automation testing
  • Strong coding skills — able to write code from scratch, not just scripts
  • Proficient in SQL for independent data validation and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on mobile or Web testing experience
    • Core Competencies:
  • Automation capability: Can design and develop automation frameworks, not just use existing tools
  • Root cause analysis: Can trace test failures or production issues back to their root cause
  • SQL & data validation: Can write complex SQL to verify data consistency and troubleshoot data-related bugs
  • Cross-platform understanding: Understands Web/App architecture, including front-end/back-end interaction, network requests, cache mechanisms, and WebView
  • UX sensitivity: Can identify experience issues from the user's perspective, not just whether functionality works
  • Test tooling: Experience building test platforms, tools, or quality infrastructure
  • Collaboration drive: Can push developers to fix issues rather than passively waiting

    • Soft Skills:

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented
  • "Destructive thinking" mindset — adept at finding system weaknesses
  • Strong communication — bridges developers and product managers
  • Quality ownership mentality — treats quality as personal responsibility

• Payment, transaction, or financial system QA experience
  • AI tooling usage experience
  • Crypto / Web3 industry background
  • Hands-on App compatibility testing experience using cloud device platforms such as Testin or WeTest
  • Weak-network testing experience using tools such as Charles or Fiddler

• Participate in the architecture design, development, and optimization of backend systems within Binance’s Web3 security domain, ensuring high performance, availability, reliability, and scalability.

  • Maintain, migrate, and upgrade existing backend and security service systems to continuously improve service quality and system stability.

  • Design and implement new services and technical solutions, working closely with product managers and cross-functional teams to translate business and security requirements into actionable technical plans.

  • Collaborate with specialist and operation teams to improve security systems, automated tools, and threat detection capabilities, enhancing operational efficiency and automation.

  • Work with analysts and data teams on data collection, cleaning, modeling, and analysis to support security-related use cases.

  • Participate in the design and implementation of backend and big data workflows for Web3 security and security control scenarios.

  • Communicate and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including global teams, to ensure smooth project execution.

• 5+ years of backend development experience, preferably in blockchain, Web3 security, anti-fraud, risk control, or related domains.

  • Solid experience in designing and delivering complex backend systems in large-scale, high-concurrency, or data-intensive environments.

  • Proficient in Java technology stack, especially Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and related frameworks.

  • Strong knowledge of MySQL and common NoSQL databases, with practical experience in backend service development and optimization.

  • Familiar with distributed systems design and middleware technologies, such as distributed caching, message queues (e.g. Kafka), service discovery, and configuration management.

  • Hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, HBase, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, or Elasticsearch.

  • Experience in data-related development, including data collection, cleaning, and real-time/batch processing.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, proactive learning attitude, and genuine interest in Web3 security challenges.

  • Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

• Knowledge of blockchain and familiarity with on-chain data.

  • Familiarity with AI, machine learning concepts.

  • Experience in performance tuning for JVM, SQL, RPC, etc.

  • Fluent in English.

job_detail_fetch.additionalPlain:
Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.
Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.
Global team, local impact.
Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.
High performance, low ego.
Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.
Impact meets opportunity.
We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.
Grow fast. Lead well.
You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension 
of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. 
Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

job_detail_fetch.descriptionPlain:
Superside is hiring an Account Director to lead and grow a portfolio of strategically important enterprise customers. You’ll own the full customer lifecycle, from pre-sale scoping through delivery, renewal, and expansion, ensuring customers see Superside as a long-term creative partner.

This role sits at the intersection of customer strategy, commercial growth, and delivery. You’ll lead cross-functional teams, manage senior stakeholders, and drive retention, expansion, and high-quality delivery across complex accounts.
job_detail_fetch.description:
Superside is hiring an Account Director to lead and grow a portfolio of strategically important enterprise customers. You’ll own the full customer lifecycle, from pre-sale scoping through delivery, renewal, and expansion, ensuring customers see Superside as a long-term creative partner.

This role sits at the intersection of customer strategy, commercial growth, and delivery. You’ll lead cross-functional teams, manage senior stakeholders, and drive retention, expansion, and high-quality delivery across complex accounts.

lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end relationship for 5–10 enterprise customers, driving retention, expansion, and executive trust.
  • Develop and execute account growth strategies, identifying upgrade and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead renewals and commercial negotiations in partnership with leadership.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and procurement teams.
  • Translate customer goals into scalable creative programs and solutions.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Producers to ensure seamless delivery across workstreams.
  • Act as the senior escalation point, resolving issues quickly and maintaining customer confidence.
  • Monitor account health, burn rates, and pacing to ensure performance and profitability.
  • Develop ROI-driven business cases that demonstrate the value of Superside’s model.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve customer outcomes.
  • Coach and develop PMs and Producers to raise the bar on delivery and customer management.
  • Partner with Creative, Product, and Operations to align on resourcing and execution.

• 5–10+ years of experience in account management or client services in creative, marketing, or digital environments.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing enterprise or high-value global accounts.
  • 3–5+ years in an account leadership role (e.g., Senior Account Manager, Group Account Manager, or equivalent).
  • Strong commercial acumen with ownership of revenue, retention, and growth targets.
  • Experience working with enterprise, SaaS, D2C, or B2B clients.
  • Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders and navigate complex organizations.
  • Experience leading and developing cross-functional teams.
  • Strong operational mindset with the ability to scale delivery while maintaining quality.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into actionable programs and outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills with a structured, solution-oriented approach.

You’ll bring together creativity, craft, and curiosity to deliver human-centered work for some of the world’s leading brands, while helping evolve how we integrate AI into creative workflows.

As a hands-on maker, you combine strong visual execution with openness to experimentation. You thrive in collaboration, bring empathy and clarity to your work, and approach every project with a growth mindset. Through your craft and curiosity, you’ll help shape the next generation of AI-enabled creative excellence at Superside.
job_detail_fetch.description:
Superside is looking for a Creative with a passion for Generative AI to produce exceptional design and visual content across branding, campaigns, and digital experiences. You’ll bring together creativity, craft, and curiosity to deliver human-centered work for some of the world’s leading brands, while helping evolve how we integrate AI into creative workflows.


As a hands-on maker, you combine strong visual execution with openness to experimentation. lists.content:
• Generate and refine visual concepts using AI tools (e.g., image generation, text-to-design, video, or layout automation).
  • Experiment with new AI workflows to enhance quality, speed, and creative expression.
  • Integrate AI-assisted assets into creative projects while preserving brand integrity and emotional impact.
  • Partner with other creatives, project managers, and customers to translate briefs into polished visual outcomes.
  • Promote open, inclusive communication and contribute to a positive, supportive team culture.
  • Embrace feedback as a tool for growth, both giving and receiving it constructively.
  • Connect design decisions to larger strategic and brand goals.
  • Apply curiosity and data-informed thinking to refine storytelling and visual direction.
  • Contribute to cross-functional creative initiatives that push boundaries and inspire others.
  • Document and share AI experiments, prompts, and results to support collective learning.
  • Balance independent ownership with active collaboration in a distributed, remote team.
  • Stay grounded under pressure, bringing curiosity, humility, and a solution-oriented mindset to every project.

• 3–5 years of experience as a designer or creative, with a portfolio showcasing strong conceptual and visual design work.
  • Demonstrated experience producing high-quality creative across branding, campaigns, and digital experiences.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and other design platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Generative AI tools and an eagerness to integrate them thoughtfully into creative workflows.
  • Solid English communication skills with the ability to understand briefs, collaborate effectively, and articulate creative ideas clearly.
  • A collaborative, ego-free approach that values empathy, feedback, and shared success.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining creative integrity and attention to detail.

lists.content:

  • A strong portfolio showcasing creative excellence across branding, presentations, and advertising, with examples of AI-enhanced work.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects with attention to detail, creative integrity, and team well-being.

job_detail_fetch.description:
Superside is hiring an Associate Director (Studio Operations) to lead the operational performance of multiple Business Units and the studios within them. You'll oversee workforce planning, operational excellence, and delivery health while leading a team of Studio Operations professionals who help our creative teams scale efficiently.

This role sits within Centralized Operations and partners closely with Studio Leadership to ensure our studios have the people, processes, and operating model needed to deliver exceptional work.

lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Studio Operations professionals, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Own workforce planning, staffing, utilization, and capacity across multiple Business Units.

  • Ensure studios operate efficiently by improving processes, workflows, and operational standards.

  • Monitor studio health through capacity planning, workload distribution, forecasting, and performance metrics.

  • Act as the operational escalation point for complex staffing, delivery, and workflow challenges.

job_detail_fetch.descriptionPlain:
Superside is looking for a Cape Town based Video Content Creator who is a content creator at heart, comfortable in front of camera, constantly watching ads, and genuinely excited by the challenge of making paid social videos that people want to stop and watch.
We’re looking for someone obsessed with new video ideas: the person who sees a Meta ad, a LinkedIn post or a weird Instagram Reel and immediately starts deconstructing why it works. What was the hook? Why did the first three seconds land? Was it the pacing, the caption style, the camera angle, the way the problem was framed? This role is for someone who naturally brings references, has ten rough ideas in the back pocket, and wants to test formats instead of waiting for a perfect brief.
This is NOT a traditional video editor role. We’re not looking for someone who only wants to sit behind Premiere Pro and polish footage after the creative thinking is done. We need a hands-on creator who can help find the idea, shape the hook, appear on camera, storyboard the concept, support the shoot, and edit the final piece into something that feels sharp and native to the feed.
You’ll work side by side with our Marketing Video Lead in Cape Town, tag-teaming concepts, shoots and edits in our dedicated studio and on location. You’ll also collaborate remotely with Superside’s wider creative team, sometimes owning projects from idea to final edit, and other times contributing to larger campaigns led by others.
Your main focus will be creating advertising and brand content for Superside, including UGC-style ads, skits, direct-to-camera videos, explainers, campaign content and quick creative experiments. You’ll also support other teams across marketing on a varied mix of projects when your creative, production or on-camera skills are needed.
You care enough about B2B and SaaS to make the work feel specific, not generic. You've got the editing and sound design chops to work confidently in Premiere Pro, the visual sense to storyboard in Figma, and the curiosity to use AI to make the work sharper, faster and more unexpected.

Your main focus will be creating advertising and brand content for Superside, including UGC-style ads, skits, direct-to-camera videos, explainers, campaign content and quick creative experiments. You care enough about B2B and SaaS to make the work feel specific, not generic. You've got the editing and sound design chops to work confidently in Premiere Pro, the visual sense to storyboard in Figma, and the curiosity to use AI to make the work sharper, faster and more unexpected.

lists.content:
Create and appear in social-first video content

➔ Be one of the recurring faces of Superside’s paid ads and social videos, including UGC-style ads, direct-to-camera videos, skits, explainers, campaign content and quick creative experiments.

➔ Work closely with the Marketing Video Lead in Cape Town to shoot regularly in our studio, as well as outdoors or in simple location-based setups when the idea calls for it.

➔ Bring natural on-camera confidence, good creative instincts and a willingness to try different formats, tones and takes until the idea lands.

Research what works and turn it into ideas

➔ Watch and deconstruct paid social ads across Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, looking closely at hooks, pacing, captions, setups, creator styles and ad structures.

➔ Bring references into brainstorms and reviews, with a clear point of view on why something works and how Superside could adapt the thinking.

➔ Develop new ad concepts, write scripts, hooks, skit setups and repeatable content formats based on customer pain points, campaign messages and paid social patterns.

Shape, shoot and edit the work

➔ Use Figma or similar tools to create simple storyboards, frame references, shot lists and rough visual plans so ideas are easier to shoot and discuss.

➔ Use Premiere Pro to create clean, effective social video edits, with strong attention to pacing, captions, sound-off viewing, structure and clarity.

➔ Support lightweight production needs in the studio, including framing, props, basic lighting, audio setup and keeping shoots moving with alternate ideas or quick adjustments.

➔ Able to do meticulous quality checks to ensure final exports are correct and up to standard before they go out.

Use AI as part of the creative process

➔ Use AI tools to support concepting, scripting, visual references, effects, editing shortcuts, production experiments or ways to make videos feel more surprising and current.

➔ Stay curious about tools like ChatGPT, Claude,, Higgsfield, Krea, Seedance or similar, without treating AI as a replacement for taste, judgment and good ideas.

➔ Share useful AI workflows, references and experiments with the team so we keep improving how we make video content.

➔ Based in Cape Town, South Africa, with the ability to work regularly from Superside’s dedicated video studio.

➔ 3+ years of experience as a content creator, social video creator, video editor, creative producer or similar hands-on role.

➔ A portfolio, social presence or content examples that clearly show you can appear on camera, perform naturally and create UGC-style videos, ads, creator content or social-first video.

➔ Strong comfort being in front of camera often, not occasionally. This role needs someone who can be a visible part of our ads and social content.

➔ Genuine interest in paid social, creator content, B2B marketing and what is currently performing in the feed.

➔ Great understanding of Meta ads, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and short-form video formats.

➔ Ability to spot strong hooks, write scripts, suggest concepts and turn references into usable ideas.

➔ Working knowledge of Premiere Pro, with enough editing & sound design skill to create tight, clear social videos in a very fast-paced environment.

➔ Comfortable using Figma or similar tools for simple storyboarding, visual planning and adding visual flair to your videos.

➔ Curious about AI tools and how they can be used in video content, social ads and creative production.

➔ Scrappy, resourceful and proactive, able to bring ideas without waiting for a perfect brief.

➔ Collaborative, low-ego and excited to work closely with video, creative, copy and growth teams.

➔ Experience working with performance marketers or paid social teams.

➔ Experience creating content for B2B, SaaS, agencies, creative services or marketing brands.

➔ Basic camera, lighting and audio setup experience.

➔ Basic motion graphics, After Effects or AI-assisted video workflow experience

job_detail_fetch.description: Superside is looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Creative Strategist on a freelance basis. Your role will sit at the intersection of brand creative strategy and paid social performance. The ideal candidate will be someone who has operated at this intersection before, ideally from inside a brand's own marketing team.

lists.content:
• Advise on current paid social trends — formats, platform shifts, and what's working now versus six months ago.
  • Recommend channel strategy — where and how brands should show up across paid social.
  • Adapt big brand campaigns for paid — determine what changes, what gets cut, and what gets re-shot or re-cut for feed vs. story vs. in-feed native.
  • Improve how creative teams get briefed — tighter, more performance-informed briefs that still protect brand integrity.
  • Advise on testing and creative automation — structure creative testing at scale (variants, hooks, iteration speed) without it becoming chaos.

• Creative or content strategy background with hands-on paid social experience (Meta, TikTok, Google Display, YouTube) — you speak both languages fluently. Not a strategist who hands off to media, and not a media buyer dabbling in creative.
  • In-house experience at a brand, not agency-only — you've operated close to the business and the numbers, not at arm's length through an agency model.
  • A track record of owning or heavily influencing paid social creative strategy — not just executing against someone else's brief. We're looking for evidence of ownership, not just production.
  • Experience producing hundreds of ads per month — confirmation that you've operated at real scale, not boutique volume.
  • Comfort being both strategist and translator — you can talk brand with a CMO and shot lists with a creative team, sometimes on the same day.

You've sat inside a brand's marketing org and felt the tension between "this needs to look right" and "this needs to perform" — and you've built the muscle to resolve that tension instead of picking a side. You can look at a hero campaign asset and immediately see the six ways it needs to fragment for paid social, and you can sit across from a creative team and turn "the CTR is soft" into a brief they can actually act on.

lists.content:

Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.
job_detail_fetch.description:
Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it.

You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

lists.content:
• Lead creative strategy across a portfolio of client accounts simultaneously, each producing a high volume of ad creative every month, while maintaining a high bar for quality.\
  • Act as the primary strategic point of contact for clients — presenting creative recommendations, test results, and performance insights directly to marketing and brand stakeholders.
  • Analyze creative and campaign performance data (CTR, hook and hold rate, CPA, ROAS, and other channel-specific metrics) and translate findings into clear, insight-driven creative briefs.
  • Build and run testing frameworks that keep creative strategy iterating quickly based on live performance signals rather than instinct alone.
  • Develop and apply platform-specific strategy across paid social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, Etc.), out-of-home/DOOH, and programmatic/DSP environments, adapting recommendations to each channel's best practices, specs, and buying dynamics.
  • Partner closely with Creative Leads, Designers, Copywriters, and Motion Artists to turn insights into concepts that are built to perform, not just look good.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with clients, becoming a strategic partner they rely on rather than an order-taker.
  • Champion AI tools and workflows across the strategy process — from research and insight-gathering to concept testing and reporting.
  • Contribute to the growth of Superside's Performance Marketing strategy practice — sharing frameworks, benchmarks, and platform expertise across the wider Strategy team.

• 5+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance marketing, or a related discipline at an agency, platform, or in-house marketing team.
  • A proven track record leading creative strategy for a high monthly volume of content — comfortable working in fast, iterative sprint cycles rather than one-off campaigns.
  • Experience managing creative strategy across multiple client accounts or brands at the same time, balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data from ads managers, analytics tools, and creative-analytics platforms to inform strategy.
  • A confident, polished communicator, able to present strategy and performance insights directly to clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Skilled at writing clear, insight-driven creative briefs that give creative teams a strong strategic foundation to work from.
  • A data-informed thinker who blends analytical rigor with creative instinct — equally at home in a spreadsheet and a brainstorm.
  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI tools and their growing role in performance creative strategy.
